segments.text: What is the Trusted News Initiative, or TNI?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Simply, Global Information Control.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The Trusted News Initiative was founded in 2019 by UK's state broadcaster, the BBC, and its global media and big tech partners.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The TNI claimed its first order of business was to promote freedom and democracy by preventing foreign interference in the 2020 US presidential election.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: But there was more.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The TNI's big pharma backers had a vaccine agenda in mind from the start.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The TNI issued a warning in 2019 that anti-vaxxers are gaining traction across the internet, requiring algorithmic intervention.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: That means very smart computer programs to identify, attack, and neutralize anti-vaccine content.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: How does the TNI work?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Flooding your screen with repetitive pro-vaccine messages that normalize the experimental vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They demonize the unvaccinated to create division and drive public acceptance of vaccine compliance.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The TNI also pays off so-called fact-checkers to run false fact checks and hit pieces on scientists and journalists who buck the official narrative.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Hundreds of frontline medical professionals, scientists, researchers who dare to speak out against the official narrative, gone, disappeared from social media by the TNI.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They didn't ask approved questions.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They didn't come to approved conclusions.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So now, top doctors from Harvard, Stanford, and Oxford are dangerous experts who must be neutralized.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: TNI director Jessica Cecile complains that anti-vax content often includes interviews with people who have medical degrees.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: There is frequently a grain of truth to what is claimed.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: That makes untangling the false hard.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They attack early treatments that cure COVID because they feel it poses a threat to the vaccine agenda.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The TNI network also ignore stories of tens of thousands that have been injured by COVID vaccines in order to promote the false narrative that they are safe and effective.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: It's not just careers the TNI is destroying, but real lives as it suppresses the true numbers on vaccine adverse effects and early treatment protocols.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Who's paying for this harmful suppression of science?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: You are, we are, we pay taxes.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The government pays big pharma and big pharma spends almost $7 billion advertising with TNI corporations.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: TNI companies also have pharma investments, massive conflicts of interest.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: See how that works?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And at the beginning of the pandemic, when it mattered, when the truth could have helped science find the origin of COVID, the TNI aggressively shut down all inquiry into this.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They called scientists who simply raised the question of virus origin as a lab leak from the Wuhan lab, conspiracy theorists.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: A year later, the so-called conspiracy theory has been deemed the most plausible scenario.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Remember Orwell's dystopia in 1984?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The Ministry of Peace made war.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The Ministry of Love tortured.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The Ministry of Truth told lies.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And in 2021, the Trusted News Initiative promotes disinformation while keeping the true science from us.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: the sharing of biased and false news has become all too common on social media.
